scope: Fresh independent adjudication of the nine requested support-labelled partial answers in the final 54-question pair.

method.grading_rule: Grade every actually requested part using that answer alone. Support labels do not determine correctness. Do not demand incidental answer-key context. Correct requires all requested parts resolved without material contradictory extra rulings; partial means at least one requested part unresolved while substantive parts are correct.

returns.evidence: Detailed execution: Each player, starting with the player to the left of the player who played the special action and continuing clockwise ... must send 3 of his own Caballeros back to the provinces. Heading: Your fellow players. Sources: any regions and/or ... court; not King’s region or Castillo.

one.evidence: You decide which Caballeros must return ... including one of your own. ... from any region ... not ... King’s region or ... Castillo.

singleton.evidence: If a player only has at most one Caballero in any region then he must select such a region. The players may not take Caballeros from the King’s region or the Castillo.

movement.evidence: Your fellow players must move all of their Caballeros out ... affected players choose another region on their secret disks ... reveal ... Players choosing the King’s region or the region they were being moved from, return their Caballeros to their courts.

general.evidence: A: may neither add to nor take from King’s region. B: simultaneously and secretly select on disks. C: any/all moved pieces may go into Castillo; removal only at general scoring. D: complete one activity before the other. E: maximum; fewer allowed. F: Special-action Caballeros may be added or moved to Castillo or any region except King’s.

three_four.evidence: Any 3: own and/or foreign, from any regions (except King’s) to any regions (except King’s) and/or Castillo. Any 4: up to 4 own and/or foreign, from any regions (except King’s) into any other regions (except King’s) and/or Castillo.

two_two.evidence: You can move 2 of your own and 2 foreign Caballeros from any regions (except the King’s) to any regions (except the King’s) and/or into the Castillo.

court.evidence: Move 2 of your Caballeros from the provinces to your court.

four_normal.evidence: Maximum of 4 Caballeros from his court into regions adjacent to King’s region or Castillo; furthermore special action executed or prevented.

findings: A Q40 and B Q40 give the same correct requested Movement rulings; A’s source-choice uncertainty is outside the requested destination consequences and preserves the taboo.
A Q49 preserves any-three versus other-regions any-four wording. Its set-wide exchange caveat does not contradict that restriction.
B Q50 positively supplies non-King regions and/or Castillo; A Q50 does not. B’s answer cannot fill A’s omission.

conclusion: Only A Q50 requires a partial correctness grade. All other assigned partial-support labels are correct on every requested part. No assigned answer is wholly incorrect.
